# oh-my-vllm — project overview

## Goals

The project builds a **Rust-first inference framework for Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on a single B200 GPU**, reaching **≥95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput** (and ≤110% TTFT in the new baseline) across batch sizes 1/2/4. The defining design decision: **Rust owns serving, scheduling and logical KV cache; Python owns GPU computation** — with no vLLM installed, imported, or linked anywhere in the runtime, build, or tests.

Sources: `README.md` (quick start / goals), `docs/requirements.md` (REQ-GOAL-001, REQ-ARCH-001, REQ-PERF-001/002), `docs/handoff.md` (active task).

Key constraints from `docs/requirements.md`:
- Target model `<local-path> **48 GDN (GatedDeltaNet/Mamba) layers + 16 full-attention layers**, hard **block size 784 tokens** (REQ-MODEL-001).
- Support 262,144 total input/output tokens; boundary check is 258048 in + 4096 out at batches 1/2/4 with no OOM/preemption (REQ-CONTEXT-001).
- Feature set: chunked prefill, continuous batching, prefix caching, recompute preemption, MTP4 speculative decoding, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions + Responses serving with thinking levels, constrained (JSON/tool) decoding, and stored-response continuation (REQ-FUNC-*, REQ-SERVE-*).
- Out of scope: multimodal, swap preemption, multi-GPU, LoRA (REQ-OUT-SCOPE-001).

## Architecture

Two processes talk over a **single ZMQ DEALER socket with msgpack**; no shared memory, no tensor crossing the boundary (`docs/architecture.md`, `docs/design.md`).

**Rust side**
- `crates/scheduler` (`crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs`): FCFS waiting/running queues, per-step token budget (`max_num_batched_tokens` default 32768, `max_num_seqs` 256), chunked prefill via budget clamping, and `aligned_prefill` which snaps prefill spans to 784-block boundaries so Mamba checkpoints materialize at block edges. `schedule()` walks the running queue first (decode before new prefill — continuous batching), then the waiting queue; on pool exhaustion it evicts the last-admitted running request back to waiting with `num_computed_tokens=0` (recompute preemption). MTP drafts are tracked via `num_tokens_with_spec()` and rolled back in `update()` when the worker rejects drafts.
- `crates/kv-cache`: shared logical block pool, chain-hash (SHA-256→64-bit) prefix cache with LRU eviction, two KV groups (FA group = 16 layers, Mamba group = 48 layers), two-phase allocation (prefix hits before fresh pages), speculative reservations, and (new, 2026-09-22) an **independent GDN pool** via `--mamba-blocks` (ADR-007).
- `crates/zmq-worker`: CLI, Axum HTTP for `<local-path>, `<local-path>, `<local-path> (incl. `previous_response_id` continuation, get/delete), model-process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ transport, correlated logging.

**Python side** (`python/oh_my_vllm/`)
- `worker/model_runner.py`: `OhMyVllmWorker` — validates config (ordinary or MTP4 only, vocab 248320), allocates per-layer cache tensors directly (`[blocks,2,784,4,256]` BF16 for FA; conv state `[slots,10240,3]` + SSM state `[slots,48,128,128]` FP32 normally, BF16 with MTP), holds per-request history/sampler state, and orchestrates `execute_model()` over `SchedulerOutput`.
- `worker/batch_plan.py` (host validation, checkpoint copies — no allocation), `worker/sampler.py` (penalties, top-k/p, greedy verification of drafts), `worker/serving.py` (chat template, tokenizer, XGrammar masks, incremental detokenization), `worker/mtp.py` (shifted MTP cache + proposal graphs), `worker/decode_graph.py` (CUDA graph capture/replay, ≤32 shapes each), `worker/runtime.py` (dependency-identity audit at startup/shutdown).
- `models/qwen.py` + `kernels/`: direct safetensors loading of the 64-layer model, FP8 GEMM via FlashInfer/CUTLASS, project-owned Triton kernels for GDN recurrence, causal conv, paged split-KV GQA decode; grouped speculative-verification attention shares one tiled KV read across up to 5 queries per request (`docs/architecture.md`).

## How to run

Everything goes through `scripts/with-env.sh` (pins conda `oh-my-vllm`, PYTHONPATH, caches) and `scripts/with-gpu.sh` (waits for idle B200, pins UUID) — `README.md`:

```bash
# build
scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker

# offline smoke (text)
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py \
  --socket <local-path> --max-tokens 64
# add --num-speculative-tokens 4 for MTP4

# benchmark vs frozen EngineCore baseline
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python benchmarks/compare_vllm.py \
  --mode ordinary --batch-sizes 1 2 4 --warmup 2 --output <local-path>

# OpenAI-compatible service at 127.0.0.1:8000/v1
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker \
  --socket <local-path> --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve
```

Verification commands (cargo test/fmt/clippy, ruff, CPU unittest suite) are listed in `README.md` and `docs/testing.md`.

## Completion status (as of 2026-09-22, `docs/handoff.md` + `docs/acceptance.md`)

**Done and accepted (2026-09-21):**
- The **independent runtime** (REQ-RUNNER-002) is complete: no vLLM dependency anywhere; all nine 32768→4096 performance rows (ordinary/mtp/prefix × batch 1/2/4) pass at ≥95% of the original frozen EngineCore baseline (ratios 96.49%–122.47%, table in `docs/acceptance.md`, raw data in `bench/baseline/2026-09-21-independent-acceptance.json`).
- Full correctness suite passes: 92 GPU tests + 12 subtests, 75 Rust tests, FP64 GQA/GDN actual-path checks, MTP4 constraint/lifecycle, both OpenAI APIs, real oh-my-pi agentic acceptance on Chat and Responses (REQ-SERVE-003).

**Active task (in progress, pending):**
- **New 12-row throughput/TTFT baseline** on the just-frozen vLLM main (SHA `e9f169d1…`): user authorized the baseline refresh on 2026-09-22; baseline env is currently building the frozen source with host CUDA 13.1, and **no new 12-row formal measurement exists yet** (REQ-PERF-001/002, `docs/requirements.md`).
- **262144-token long-context boundary**: all six ordinary/MTP4 batch 1/2/4 boundary runs (258048 in + 4096 out) completed with zero preemptions (peak ~135 GiB ordinary / ~140 GiB MTP4); a signed int32 decode page-offset overflow was found and fixed with FP64 regression tests (`docs/handoff.md`, `docs/acceptance.md` stage evidence in `bench/baseline/2026-09-22-ttft-stage1.json`).
- Implemented but not yet accepted: per-request TTFT measurement, the independent GDN pool (`--mamba-blocks`, ADR-007), and formal measurement/provenance checks. 77 Rust tests and a full 100-test GPU pytest pass.

In short: the framework, independent runtime, serving and 95% performance gate are complete and accepted; the remaining work is the new frozen-baseline 12-row throughput+TTFT measurement and its formal acceptance.

responses.final_text:
# oh-my-vllm

## Project goals

A **Rust-first inference framework for Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU**, built to match at least **95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput** on the benchmark matrix in `docs/requirements.md` (REQ-GOAL-001, REQ-PERF-001). Key hard constraints (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/requirements.md`):

- **Target model**: `<local-path> — a hybrid of **48 GatedDeltaNet (GDN/Mamba) layers + 16 full-attention (FA) layers** (`docs/requirements.md` REQ-MODEL-001).
- **Block size 784 tokens** — a hard, non-negotiable hybrid-architecture constraint (`README.md`, REQ-MODEL-001).
- **Rust owns serving, scheduling, and logical KV allocation; Python owns GPU computation.** The boundary is a single ZMQ DEALER socket with msgpack — no shared memory, no tensor crossing (`docs/architecture.md`, REQ-ARCH-001).
- **No vLLM anywhere**: builds, tests, and inference must not install, import, link, or depend on vLLM, its source, or the old vllm conda env (`AGENTS.md`, REQ-RUNNER-002).
- Current work item: a **new 12-row throughput+TTFT baseline on refreshed official vLLM main** (frozen SHA `e9f169d…`) plus **262144-token context support** (REQ-PERF-002, REQ-CONTEXT-001).

## Architecture

The runtime is two processes (`README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`):

**Rust side** (workspace, `Cargo` crates):
- `crates/scheduler` — `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs`: FCFS waiting→running queues, per-step token budget (chunked prefill falls out of `remaining.min(budget)`), continuous batching (decode scheduled before new prefills), prefix-cache lookup and block allocation via `HybridCoordinator`, **recompute preemption** (last running request evicted, blocks freed), and MTP4 speculative-decoding accounting with draft rollback.
- `crates/kv-cache` — shared logical block pool, chain-hashed (SHA-256→64-bit) prefix cache with LRU, aligned Mamba checkpoints, speculative reservations; two-phase allocation touches reused prefixes before new pages (`docs/architecture.md`, REQ-FUNC-003).
- `crates/zmq-worker` — CLI, OpenAI-compatible HTTP (Chat Completions + Responses, streaming, tools, JSON constraints, stored Responses), model-process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ transport, correlated logging (`README.md`, REQ-SERVE-001).

**Python side** (`python/oh_my_vllm/`, project-owned):
- `python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py` — the concrete `OhMyVllmWorker`: loads the model, allocates per-layer cache tensors at the Rust-reported logical capacity, maintains persistent per-request history/sampler state, and `execute_model` orchestrates execution per `SchedulerOutput` from Rust; supports `speculative_tokens ∈ {0, 4}` and optional independent `mamba_blocks`.
- `worker/` modules: `batch_plan.py` (host validation, checkpoint copies), `sampler.py` (penalties, top-k/p, exact greedy verification), `serving.py` (tokenizer, XGrammar masks, incremental decoding), `mtp.py`, `decode_graph.py` (CUDA graphs, ≤32 shapes each for target and proposer), `runtime.py` (module/library audit proving no legacy vLLM dependencies).
- `models/qwen.py` — direct safetensors loading, 64-layer target + one-layer MTP head sharing embedding/output weights.
- Kernels: project-owned **Triton** GDN recurrence, causal conv, paged split-KV GQA decode, RoPE, fusions; **FlashInfer** for FP8 GEMM and long prefill; CUDA graphs for decode (`docs/architecture.md` "Device kernels and graphs").

**Execution flow** (`docs/architecture.md`): Rust normalizes/admits requests and allocates FA+Mamba tables → scheduler batches prefill/decode/MTP drafts → Python validates history/state, runs the model, samples with per-draft grammar masks → Python commits retained outputs and MTP proposals → Rust updates accepted history and rolls back rejections. GDN state is `[slot,48,128,128]` FP32 (BF16 under MTP); FA pages are 784 tokens with boundary snapshots checkpointed; MTP row p uses target hidden[p-1] with a uniform +1 RoPE shift so every row matches Rust's prefix hash.

## How to run it

Everything goes through two wrappers: `scripts/with-env.sh` (conda `oh-my-vllm` env, `PYTHONPATH`, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, independent kernel caches) and `scripts/with-gpu.sh` (waits for an idle B200 — no compute processes, ≤64 MiB used, zero utilization — then pins the UUID) (`docs/development.md`, `README.md`).

```bash
# install + build
scripts/with-env.sh python -m pip install -r requirements/runtime.txt
scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker

# smoke test (64 tokens), MTP via --num-speculative-tokens 4
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py --socket <local-path> --max-tokens 64

# benchmark (ordinary | mtp | prefix), frozen EngineCore baseline comparison
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python benchmarks/compare_vllm.py --mode ordinary --batch-sizes 1 2 4 --warmup 2 --output <local-path>

# local OpenAI service (Chat + Responses at http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1)
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker --socket <local-path> --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve
```

Verification suite: `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `scripts/check_rust_line_width.py`, `clippy -- -D warnings`, `ruff format/check python/`, and CPU unittest discovery (`README.md`, `docs/development.md`).

## Current completion status (2026-09-22, per `docs/handoff.md`, `docs/acceptance.md`)

**Done and accepted:**
- **Independent runtime complete** (previous task): no installed/imported/linked vLLM; V2 adapter removed. All **nine** 32768→4096 performance rows (ordinary/MTP/prefix × batch 1/2/4) pass the ≥95% gate against the original frozen EngineCore baseline, ranging **96.49%–122.47%** (`docs/acceptance.md`, `bench/baseline/2026-09-21-independent-acceptance.json`).
- GPU pytest 100 tests + 12 subtests, no skips; 77 Rust tests; fmt/clippy/ruff/pre-commit all green; actual-model FP64 GQA/GDN probes pass original tolerances.
- OpenAI serving (Chat + Responses, tools, JSON constraints, thinking levels, stored Responses) accepted with real MTP4 runs, including real oh-my-pi agentic tasks on both APIs.

**In progress — not yet accepted:**
- **New 12-row baseline + TTFT gates** on refreshed official vLLM main (SHA `e9f169d16b9408bb9ae44f75072b91a5521d733c`): baseline env adaptation is mid-flight — the exact cu130 wheel was unavailable, so the frozen source is being built with host CUDA 13.1 (`<local-path>). No formal 12-row result exists yet; both ≥95% throughput and ≤110% TTFT gates per row are pending (REQ-PERF-001/002).
- **262144-token context (REQ-CONTEXT-001): functionally verified, formally pending.** All six 258048-input + 4096-output boundary checks (ordinary/MTP4 × batch 1/2/4) completed **without OOM or recompute preemption** (peak reserved ≈134.9 GiB ordinary / ≈140.0 GiB MTP4); a signed int32 decode page-offset overflow was found and fixed with FP64 high-page regression tests; long-context uses `--max-model-len 262144 --num-gpu-blocks 4200 --mamba-blocks 128` with independent FA/GDN pools (ADR-007). These are cold diagnostics, not formal measurements.
- Implemented but awaiting acceptance: per-request TTFT, optional independent GDN pool, formal measurement/provenance checks, corrected Qwen3.8 naming.

In short: the framework is functionally complete and has passed its original performance and serving acceptance; the open work is the refreshed 12-row throughput/TTFT baseline acceptance and formal sign-off on the 262144-context runs (`docs/handoff.md`, `docs/acceptance.md`).

**Files cited:** `README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/requirements.md`, `docs/handoff.md`, `docs/acceptance.md`, `docs/development.md`, `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs`, `python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py`, plus referenced artifacts under `bench/baseline/`.
